latest.title: A topological version of Huber's theorem
latest.abstract: Let $X$ be a closed hyperbolic surface. We prove that the number of topological types of primitive closed geodesics of length at most $L$ is asymptotic to \[ \frac{1}{|\Isom(X)|}\frac{e^L}{2L}. \] as $L$ grows. Thus Huber's asymptotic remains unchanged after quotienting by topological type, up to the finite symmetry factor coming from the isometry group of $X$.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 对闭双曲曲面证明，长度不超过 L 的本原闭测地线拓扑类型数具有与 Huber 计数相同的指数主阶，仅差有限等距群因子。
techniques: 测地流与 Liouville current 集中
映射类群在 filling currents 上的适当性
有限等距群固定曲线计数
latest.breakthrough: 说明按拓扑类型去重后仍保留几乎全部指数增长信息。
latest.limitations: 主结果针对闭可定向双曲曲面的无定向本原闭测地线；按全映射类群定义拓扑型，不能忽略对称群因子或直接推广到非紧曲面。
latest.priorityReason: 曲面动力系统与拓扑计数间的简明新联系，主项明确；技术细节与有效误差仍需专门阅读。
